description: Implementation of the VertexDeclarationCache class for managing and caching Direct3D 9 vertex declarations in ANGLE project, including methods for applying vertex declarations, handling instancing, and cache management.

classes.name: VertexDeclarationCache
classes.description: A helper class to construct and cache vertex declarations for Direct3D 9 in ANGLE.

methods.name: applyDeclaration
methods.description: Constructs and applies a vertex declaration based on provided attributes, handling instancing and caching for efficiency.

methods.name: markStateDirty
methods.description: Resets internal state to force reapplication of vertex declarations and disables instancing.
